surprise.heroSub: For families, loved ones or partners living in Beirut — checking in on someone who is sick, sharing in their joy, or comforting them in sorrow. We make it possible to be there, even from afar.

groupSubtitle.birthday: On your behalf, we deliver birthday wishes, blessings, or expressions of love the way you ask us to.
groupSubtitle.event: When you can't be there for a feast, a funeral, or an illness, we attend on your behalf and show your loved ones how much they mean to you.

surprise.giftIntro:
If you have a girlfriend in Arab countries who will one day be your 'future wife', you can end her lonely, slow life of exile with a sweet new breath of life — send her a 'Will You Marry Me' or a surprise on our behalf and make her happy.

Or if you have a brave wife who worked abroad for her home, her marriage and her children — by sending her the different wedding-anniversary surprises, you too can tell her your love, renew her love, and even honor her in front of her employers.

For that too, we are here.

surprise.tihunSub: Event & surprise services in Beirut for the Ethiopian community — birthdays, feasts, sympathy visits, gift delivery and more.

tihun.quote: 💞 "As long as the heart stays close, distance and a country's borders cannot keep people apart!"
tihun.intro: Bringing families separated by country and work back together through feeling is the main goal of the Tihun surprise service.
tihun.story: We turn the distance and the loneliness between Ethiopia and Lebanon (Beirut) into love and memory. To tell the dear daughter in Beirut "Happy Birthday!" on your behalf, to stand beside a relative in Beirut when they get married, when they mourn, or when they fall sick, and give them what they need — {{brand}} together with Tihun is always ready.
tihun.pillTitle: Our service is arranged into three main branches:

hardship.title: For Hardship, Mourning & Wedding Times
hardship.text: To visit the sick and stand beside someone during mourning, representing you.

love.title: For Love & Marriage
love.text: To help a loved one propose and celebrate an anniversary beautifully in Beirut.

tihun.promise: Wherever you are, the longing of your heart reaches its place — we work faithfully!
tihun.final: For the girl who melts like a candle to keep her family — this is, truly, an act of gratitude she deserves!!

about.hero: {{name}} — the biggest Ethiopian marketplace built with our dear brothers and sisters in mind, the ones working in Arab countries (Lebanon, Saudi Arabia, Dubai, Qatar, Kuwait and others) as domestic workers and in various jobs.
about.hero2: For those of you with no time to go shopping in person, we gather every need — food, clothes, cosmetics — in one website. Instead of buying from many places and paying many delivery riders, we pack everything together and deliver in one trip. Because every product is described in detail, customers buy with full information and total peace of mind.
about.builtBy: Built by Ethiopians, for Ethiopians Living in Arab Countries

steps: Place your order from your phone

about.missionP1: To make shopping easier for every Ethiopian living in Arab countries by connecting customers, merchants and delivery partners on one trusted marketplace.
about.missionP2: We believe every Ethiopian should reach food, groceries, clothes and beauty products quickly, safely and conveniently, no matter where they live or work.
